model_choice: Exact binary formulation with linear constraints. Variables: 2N (N station candidates + N coverage indicators). For N=24, 48 variables. Fits backend (limit 3600). Constraints are linear, handled by system penalties. Objective is linear maximization of covered population.

candidates.meaning: Index of a candidate site (a 'li' center)

coverage.meaning: Binary matrix indicating if candidate j covers li i

prep.notes: Filtered boundary and population data to Da'an District, Taipei City. Converted projected TWD97 TM2 coordinates to WGS84. Aggregated population to village level using latest period and total gender. Joined boundary and population on District and Village names. Computed pairwise coverage matrix for 1km radius. All IDs are full village names (e.g., '臺北市大安區龍坡里').
